Klasse GraphicsBase.EditingCallbackParameter

java.lang.Object
com.flexganttfx.view.graphics.GraphicsBase.EditingCallbackParameter
Umschließende Klasse:
GraphicsBase<R extends Row<?,?,?>>
public static final class GraphicsBase.EditingCallbackParameter extends Object
A callback parameter object used for determining if the proposed GraphicsBase.EditMode is currently allowed or not. The editing callback is used to enable / disable specific editing operations.
